components.css: .ds-tag{position:relative;display:inline-block;padding:.7em 1.1em .65em;border:0;background:var(--pink,#ff48b0);color:var(--soot,#1d1d1b);font:800 1rem/1 Archivo,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.01em;cursor:pointer;transform:rotate(-2.5deg);mix-blend-mode:multiply;transition:transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle 3px at 0 50%,transparent 98%,#000) left/51% 100% no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle 3px at 100% 50%,transparent 98%,#000) right/51% 100% no-repeat;mask:radial-gradient(circle 3px at 0 50%,transparent 98%,#000) left/51% 100% no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle 3px at 100% 50%,transparent 98%,#000) right/51% 100% no-repeat}.ds-tag::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:4px;border:1.5px dashed rgb(29 29 27/.55);pointer-events:none}.ds-tag:hover{transform:rotate(-1deg) translateY(-1px)}.ds-tag:active{transform:rotate(-1deg) scale(.96);transition-duration:60ms}.ds-tag:focus-visible{outline:2px dashed var(--pink,#ff48b0);outline-offset:5px}.ds-tag svg{width:1em;height:1em;vertical-align:-.14em;margin-right:.4em}

narrative.overview:
The world is printed, not rendered. Newsprint paper carries a fixed multiply grain over everything; the map is riso blue linework with a rotated halftone for land; every flight is a pass of fluorescent pink ink. There is no screen light in this system: nothing glows, nothing floats on a shadow, and nothing is dark-mode. Depth comes only from ink layering, where pink and blue print over each other in `mix-blend-mode: multiply` and misregister by a pixel or two.

The map is a full-bleed flat Mercator spread (80N to 72S), bottom-anchored so Antarctica stays open, letterboxed with paper margins above a 17:10 aspect and pannable at full height on portrait. Chrome is printed onto the spread: one full-measure condensed headline band across the Arctic, a caption and counter on paper strips, a pink stamped tag. Below the fold, the sheet continues as plain paper.

Density is low on type and high on map. The product principle "the map is the product" is the layout rule: everything that is not map sits on paper strips or in one card, and yields to the map.
keyCharacteristics: Two inks (blue, pink) plus soot on newsprint; any purple is an overprint, never a picked color.
Off-register layering: second-ink passes sit 1-2px (or ~.014em) away from the first.
Square corners everywhere; edges are cut, stamped, dashed or perforated.
One condensed grotesk at 900 for display bands; one plain grotesk for reading.
Motion is ink behavior: presses, stamps, drying trails. No bounce, no glow.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Only blue and pink are inks. Purple exists solely where they overprint (the plane's fold facet: blue at .55 opacity multiplied over pink). Never pick a purple, green or any third ink.

rules.name: The Soot Reads Rule
rules.body: Text under display size is soot. Blue is linework and display ink (headlines, big numerals); pink is fill, never text on paper.

rules.name: The Map Comes First Rule
rules.body: The display headline is one compact line in the top-left corner; it never grows into a band that covers the map.
rules.section: The display headline is one compact line in the top-left corner; it never grows into a band that covers the map.

rules.name: The Volume Is Scale Rule
rules.body: Quantity is shown by numeral size, not by a chart or badge.

rules.name: The Misregistration Rule
rules.body: Layering is shown by a second ink pass slightly out of register, printed with multiply: the pink outline ghost of the land (offset 1.6, 1.1), the card's pink frame (offset 2px, 1.5px), the headline's pink under-pass (offset .014em, .01em). The headline pass sits under the blue, because multiplying these two inks over each other yields navy and erases the blue title.

rules.name: The Nothing Glows Rule
rules.body: No light effects of any kind. If something needs emphasis, it gets more ink (solid fill, denser halftone), not light.

dos: **Do** print every overlapping ink layer with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`.
**Do** offset a second ink pass 1-2px (or ~.014em on display type) off the first; put pink under blue on headlines.
**Do** set reading text in soot on paper; put text on pink in soot.
**Do** keep every corner square and every edge a rule, a dash or a cut.
**Do** lay chrome on paper strips over the map rather than letting text sit on linework.
**Do** use the shared ease-out curve (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) for presses and state changes, 60-220ms.
**Do** keep hover content reachable by tap and keyboard focus.
donts: **Don't** add a third ink or hand-pick a purple; purple only happens where blue multiplies over pink.
**Don't** use drop shadows, glows, blurs or gradients for depth.
**Don't** set small text in blue or any text in pink on paper; neither reaches reading contrast.
**Don't** print the pink headline pass over the blue; the multiply turns the title navy.
**Don't** crop the world on wide screens; letterbox with paper margins instead.
